text: Ladies and gentlemen, from the corner of pure pressure, built from a real photo and wrapped in a charcoal rash guard, standing one point seven nine meters tall! The fit pass tightened that rash guard and blended the lower neck, lifting clothing from four to five and realism from thirty-eight to thirty-nine! But champ, that collar is shiny and pleated, the shorts split at the hip, and you are fighting on tiptoe like a ballerina! Approved for battle, give it up for the Pressure Cooker, THE OWNER!
